headline: TD Synnex posts record quarter, cash flow turns negative
summary_short: TD Synnex's fiscal Q2 2026 revenue rose 31.0% y/y to $19.57B, with net income up 80.7% to $334M and diluted EPS of $4.15, even as operating cash flow turned negative on a $2.95B inventory build.
summary_long: Revenue rose 31.0% y/y to $19.57 billion, driven by broad-based strength across the Distribution and Hyve businesses per CEO Patrick Zammit, and came in above the high end of the company's prior outlook. Gross margin slipped 16bp y/y to 6.84% even as operating margin expanded 45bp to 2.65%, and net income rose 80.7% to $334M ($4.15 diluted EPS; non-GAAP $4.85, +62.2%). Operating cash flow was -$266M as a $2.95B inventory build outpaced a $3.20B rise in accounts payable; cash fell to $1.09B from $2.44B at fiscal year-end. TD SYNNEX guided Q3 FY2026 revenue of $18.2-$19.0 billion and non-GAAP diluted EPS of $4.25-$4.75, and declared a $0.48/share dividend, up 9% y/y.
